note: Code derivation: data/guatemala_2024_homes.do (rename block lines 164-179; Bookmark #14: Public clinic / hospital, lines 806-846) lowercases every column and renames P05A03, P05A03A1..A13, P05A03B to pc_p05a03, pc_p05a03a1..pc_p05a03a13, pc_p05a03b (prefix-only, number-preserving rename; exempt from Step 5b). The INE data dictionary (ENCASBA.2024_Diccionarios.xlsx, sheet Hogares, positions 143-157) labels each column, 15/15, and the codes are the questionnaire's own printed question numbers (P05A03; P05A03A rows 1-13; P05A03B). Step 3b: the table is named publicclinic and described as 'public hospitals and clinics', but the block is the questionnaire's public-HOSPITAL block (P05A03, 'algún hospital público'); the public health-centre block P05A02 is guatemala_2024_homes_publichealth, not this table; instrument field names the hospital block. Words are the official Spanish questionnaire p.7 (checked against the rendered page image at 200 dpi), not the dictionary labels: 13/15 dictionary labels are character-identical to the questionnaire; dictionary label variants not shipped: A7 dictionary 'enferemería' (typo) vs questionnaire 'enfermería'; A10 dictionary has a double space ('usted  ha'), questionnaire single space. Printed line breaks (P05A03 stem, A13, B) joined with a single space. Structure: P05A03 (household attended a public hospital in 2024, yes/no) is an item with its own stem -> section _1, no prompt; the P05A03A lead-in 'El hospital público al cual asistió o asiste:' is shared by A1-A13 -> section_prompt of section _2; P05A03B -> section _3, no prompt. No whole-table instructions. Interviewer lines 'Espere la respuesta.' / 'Lea las opciones.' and the skip instruction 'PASE A PREGUNTA P05A04' not shipped. Options as printed: P05A03 SÍ 1 / NO 2; A1-A13 SÍ 1 / NO 2 / NS 3 (dictionary value labels identical); the do-file recodes only 98, so resp 3 NS (don't know) is kept on A1-A13 (nominal yes/no/don't-know, not ordinal). P05A03B prints bare 1-10 bubbles plus 98 'NO SABE / NO RESPONDE' (dictionary value labels = own number, including 98 labelled '98'); option_text for resp 1 and 10 carries the endpoint anchors defined in the stem, 2-9 left blank; code 98 set missing by the do-file without dropping rows. Skip pattern: P05A03=2 (NO, 5,083 households) routes to P05A04; in the source xlsx exactly those 5,083 are blank on A1-A13 and B, and all 1,803 P05A03=1 households are non-blank on all fourteen. Route 9 (server-side GROUP BY on the live table, no export) against ENCASBA.2024_Hogares.xlsx value counts: 51/51 valid item x resp cells equal (p05a03 1/2 = 1803/5083; a1 1/2/3 = 1189/606/8; a2 1365/423/15; a3 1390/397/16; a4 1230/520/53; a5 1453/310/40; a6 1201/565/37; a7 1336/417/50; a8 1346/401/56; a9 1591/174/38; a10 913/872/18; a11 822/958/23; a12 1583/213/7; a13 60/1732/11; b 1..10 = 73/34/54/75/197/113/212/367/189/447) and all 14 NULL cells equal source blanks (+98 for b): a1-a13 5083 each, b 5083+42=5125. Live: 103,290 rows (= 15 x 6,886), 6,886 ids, 103,290 distinct id-item, 71,204 NULL resp (68.9%).
